subject.why: The subject is clearly an overflowing sack of gold coins tied with rope, complete with the green gem requested in the brief.

category.why: The bag floats cleanly in the air with no ground or surface, shown in three-quarter view against a vibrant background with radiating rays.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The bag is centrally positioned with comfortable margins on all four sides.

colour.why: The palette is saturated and bright, and the warm golds and tans pop clearly off the vibrant lime green background.

detail.why: The volumes are kept smooth and chunky with no noisy burlap textures, scratches, or micro-details.

style.why: Matches the reference style seamlessly with soft lighting, smooth satin clay surfaces, and no outlines.
